title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel-rt security update
description: A critical security vulnerability (CVE-2026-98432) affects the kernel-rt packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 Real Time. The flaw involves improper freeing of inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period in the IPv4 kernel code. This update addresses the issue by correcting the memory management in the kernel. The kernel-rt packages provide a real-time Linux kernel for systems requiring high determinism. Red Hat has released a security advisory with patches and recommends rebooting systems after applying the update.
